item.title: Banditry: Zamfara gov calls for renewed commitment from security agencies
item.description: Zamfara State Governor, Dauda Lawal, has urged federal security agencies operating in the state to renew their commitment and strengthen collaboration in the fight against insecurity. The governor made the call on Wednesday during a two-day end-of-year tour of security formations across the state. item.title: No court order served on EFCC for ex-AGF, Malami’s release – Okutepa
item.description: The lead counsel to the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC), Chief Jibrin Samuel Okutepa, SAN, has dismissed claims that a court order directing the release of former Attorney-General of the Federation Abubakar Malami, SAN, has been served on the anti-graft agency in the ongoing N8.7 billion alleged money laundering case. item.title: ‘It must end now’ – Israel warns against Christian genocide in Nigeria
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister, Benjamin Netanyahu has warned against alleged ongoing genocide against Christian faithful in Nigeria. item.title: Dangote defeated bandits in petroleum sector, power is next – Joe Igbokwe
item.description: A leader of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Joe Igbokwe, has said that billionaire businessman Aliko Dangote has defeated those he called “bandits” in Nigeria’s petroleum sector. Igbokwe also said that people he described as bandits in the power generation, transmission, and distribution sector would be the next to be tackled. item.title: Christmas: Akpabio tells Nigerians to embrace peace, urges other faiths to partake in celebration
item.description: President of the Senate, Senator Godswill Akpabio, has called on Nigerians to use the Christmas season to promote peace, love and unity across the country, urging other faiths to join in the celebration of Christ. Akpabio made the call in his Christmas message to Nigerians, particularly Christians, as they celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ. item.description: Many Nigerians across the country are celebrating this year’s Christmas in darkness following a nationwide drop in power supply. item.title: Sheikh Gumi files criminal complaint against Facebook users over alleged death threats, defamation

item.title: Armed bandits attack Katsina town, injure residents after peace parley
item.description: Armed bandits on Tuesday night attacked Ingawa town in Katsina State, injuring several residents and looting homes, just weeks after a peace parley was held with local government officials and traditional leaders.
